title: Worker probes
content: Worker probes Current worker probe scope is local-safe and diagnostics-first. Remote execution remains disabled in this phase. 2026-05-09 guarded remote probe seam update Added guarded remote probe request/response contracts for explicit operator-invoked HTTP health checks only. Remote HTTP probes enforce URL scheme validation ( http / https ), bounded timeouts, and degraded-state mapping for timeout/auth/network/malformed response cases. Added SSH probe descriptor placeholder returning explicit not_implemented degraded status with no remote command execution. Remote probe diagnostics/receipts redact auth token/header values and preserve explicit degraded truth
summary: Current worker probe scope is local-safe and diagnostics-first. Remote execution remains disabled in this phase.
